title: Judgments for support.
bodyText: Notwithstanding section 657-5 and any other law to the contrary, every judgment for child support, including a judgment for reimbursement or other arrears, shall be enforceable until paid in full.
bodyHtml: §657-5.5  Judgments for support.  Notwithstanding section 657-5 and any other law to the contrary, every judgment for child support, including a judgment for reimbursement or other arrears, shall be enforceable until paid in full. [L 1997, c 294, §1; am L 2021, c 36, §1]
